rows.grounds: concluding particle marking end of enumeration
compound naming the collection; internal members joined by sandhi/compounding
denotes the group or collection of a thousand

items.question: Under what title is the preceding thousandfold enumeration concluded?
premises: The particle iti marks a conclusion.
The compound śrī+sarvasāmrājya+medhā+nāma provides a specific designation.
The term sahasrakam denotes a collection of a thousand.
items.inference: The preceding enumeration is concluded as the thousand named śrī-sarvasāmrājya-medhā.
uncertainties: The precise referent of medhā within the compound title is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Thus concludes the thousand named Śrī Sarvasāmrājya Medhā.
